title: Expected sum of long-path indicators
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $P$ be a finite list of paths on $n$ coordinates, and let $k$ be a natural number. For a uniformly random input $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, the expected sum of the indicators of the paths in $P$ whose lengths exceed $k$ equals the sum, over those paths, of $2^{-\ell}$, where $\ell$ is the path length.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of paths on $n$ coordinates
